answer: Because the mesa cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the zephyr ledger, the oasis audit publishes how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 21 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Each copy needs 3 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
